articles.title: Vegetation greenness and heat load drive the movements of a water-dependent, selective grazer
articles.summary: Low-density, selective grazers with restricted habitat requirements may be particularly vulnerable to extinction under hotter, drier conditions expected across Africa’s drylands with climate change. We evaluated how spatiotemporal variation in vegetation greenness and environmental heat load influenced movements of sable antelope, a water-dependent African grazer with selective resource requirements. We recorded hourly Global Positioning System (GPS) locations of 10 sable antelopes (Hippotragus niger) in Bwabwata National Park, Namibia, for up to 24 months, with concurrent hourly measurements of environmental heat load. As conditions became hotter and vegetation became browner during the dry season, home ranges increased in size and elongated towards the Kavango River. The 24-hour mean hourly displacement distance of sable antelopes increased in response to increased heat load and brown vegetation exposure, primarily due to more frequent long-distance movements to the Kavango River during the late dry season. Using Hidden Markov Models (HMMs), we identified four behavioural states of movement from GPS movement tracks: resting, foraging, local movement, and relocating. The relocating state, which was generally associated with directed movements to surface water, predominated during the late dry season. articles.contributions_limitations: 主要贡献在于整合高分辨率GPS追踪和环境热量数据，利用HMM识别四种行为状态，揭示了热量负荷和植被褐化对移动行为（如向水源地迁移）的量化影响，为理解气候胁迫下选择性食草动物的行为可塑性提供了实证。局限性包括样本量较小（仅10只个体，单一地点），且未直接测量土壤或碳循环变量，行为变化对生态系统的级联效应尚待验证；摘要细节不足，部分推断基于现有信息。
articles.follow_up_research: 后续研究可探索黑马羚移动模式变化（如集中水源地活动）如何影响局部植被异质性和土壤有机碳分布，将动物介导的营养级联与碳循环模型耦合；也可在更大空间尺度和多物种种群中验证热量阈值效应。
articles.next_step_perspective: 该研究提供了方法借鉴：利用HMM区分行为状态并结合环境变量来分析大型食草动物对气候胁迫的响应，可扩展至重野化场景中评估放牧压力再分配对土壤碳的间接影响。它提示了未来研究可关注动物移动驱动的热点区域碳沉积（如沿河地带），这是在rewilding碳评估中需考虑的空间异质性视角。
articles.why_this_journal: 推测发表于Oecologia因其结合行为生态学与全球变化生物学，聚焦物种-环境互作的机制性研究，适合该期刊强调的生态生理与行为适应主题；方法严谨（长时间GPS数据与建模）符合期刊标准。

articles.title: Bacterial community composition changes independently of soil edaphic parameters following localized permafrost disturbance
articles.summary:
Bacterial community composition changes independently of soil edaphic parameters following localized permafrost disturbance
                    Patrick Neuberger, Alireza Saidi-Mehrabad, Duane Froese, and Brian Lanoil
                        Biogeosciences, 23, 5239–5253, https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-23-5239-2026, 2026
                        Permafrost is at increased risk of thaw due to climate change and anthropogenic disturbances. As permafrost thaws, the microbiomes within these systems may become more active and change in composition, releasing greenhouse gases such as CO2 and CH4. In this study, we determined that permafrost thaw caused by road construction caused permafrost microbiomes to become more similar to surface soils, which has implications for greenhouse gas modelling.

articles.title: Lack of behavioral response of a native crayfish to the invasive predatory swamp eel
articles.summary: Invasive predators are globally pervasive and frequently drive ecological disruption, yet the mechanisms underlying extreme prey vulnerability often remain unclear. Prey that fail to recognize or appropriately respond to novel predators may experience disproportionality high mortality. In the Florida Everglades, the recent invasion of the Asian Swamp eel (Monopterus albus/javanensis) has been associated with rapid collapse of slough crayfish (Procambarus fallax), and other prey of nesting wading birds. We assessed the behaviors of slough crayfish exposed to either a common native predator, warmouth (Lepomis gulosus) or invasive Asian swamp eels. Consistent with established antipredator responses of aquatic invertebrates facing visually oriented fish predators, crayfish reduced their movement, increased spatial avoidance, and decreased feeding in the presence of warmouth. In contrast, crayfish exhibited limited or no response to swamp eels. Naïve crayfish from invaded and uninvaded wetlands showed similar responses to the different fish predators, suggesting limited recognition/responsiveness despite > 10 generations of exposure to eels. Laboratory observations of predation by swamp eels suggest that slough crayfish may face a behavioral trade-off, with native predators selecting for cryptic lifestyles while coexistence with swamp eels favors more movement and active escape responses. articles.title: A high-resolution perspective on climate drivers of lake stratification and phototrophic community dynamics in Late Glacial Central Europe
articles.summary:
A high-resolution perspective on climate drivers of lake stratification and phototrophic community dynamics in Late Glacial Central Europe
                    Petra Zahajská, María Luján García, Stella Birlo, Andrea Lami, Martina Stebich, Stan J. Schouten, Noé R. M. M. Schmidhauser, Bernd Zolitschka, Hendrik Vogel, and Martin Grosjean
                        Biogeosciences, 23, 5281–5312, https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-23-5281-2026, 2026
                        We analyzed sediments from Holzmaar using hyperspectral imaging and geochemistry to track ecosystem responses to rapid warming. We found that while rising temperatures enabled stratification, forest expansion was the decisive trigger for deep-water anoxia by shielding the lake from wind. Holzmaar’s iron-rich geology prevented internal nutrient recycling, allowing immediate recovery once the climate cooled. This proves catchment traits and lithology can override direct climate impacts.

articles.title: Biogeochemical controls on carbonate dynamics driven by methane and freshwater inputs in shallow sediments of a brackish continental shelf sea
articles.summary:
Biogeochemical controls on carbonate dynamics driven by methane and freshwater inputs in shallow sediments of a brackish continental shelf sea
                    Katarzyna Łukawska-Matuszewska, Grzegorz Rzepa, Aleksandra Brodecka-Goluch, Andrzej Borkowski, Beata Gebus-Czupyt, Artur Błachowski, Maciej Manecki, Jarosław Kania, Maciej Dwornik, and Magdalena Radzikowska
                        Biogeosciences, 23, 5255–5279, https://doi.org/10.5194/bg-23-5255-2026, 2026
                        Sedimentary processes play a crucial role in regulating the marine carbon cycle. This includes the critical roles of methanogenesis and anaerobic methane oxidation, especially when combined with freshening of pore water, which enhances the generation of dissolved inorganic carbon and promotes carbonate precipitation in sediments; additionally, methane-bearing sediments are a more significant source of dissolved inorganic carbon to overlying water than those lacking significant methanogenesis.
articles.title_zh: 浅海陆架沉积物中甲烷和淡水输入驱动的碳酸盐动态的生物地球化学控制
articles.key_conclusion: 沉积物中的产甲烷作用和厌氧甲烷氧化，结合孔隙水淡化，促进了溶解无机碳的生成和碳酸盐沉淀；含甲烷沉积物是上覆水体溶解无机碳的重要来源。
articles.relevance_note: 该研究聚焦海洋沉积物碳循环中的甲烷与碳酸盐动态，属于陆地生态系统碳循环的邻近领域（尽管是海洋环境），但未直接涉及放牧、植被-土壤反馈或动物介导过程，相关性一般。

articles.scientific_question: 在半咸水陆架海的浅层沉积物中，甲烷生成、厌氧甲烷氧化及淡水输入如何协同控制碳酸盐动态和溶解无机碳的释放？
articles.contributions_limitations: 贡献：阐明了孔隙水淡化增强甲烷相关过程、促进碳酸盐沉淀的机制，并证明含甲烷沉积物是上覆水体溶解无机碳的重要源，强化了对海洋碳循环中沉积物过程的理解。局限性：基于现有信息推测，研究聚焦特定海域的浅层沉积物，结果可能不直接适用于深水或开阔海洋系统。
articles.follow_up_research: 未来可量化不同甲烷通量梯度下溶解无机碳释放对水体碳收支的贡献，并探究淡水输入频率变化（如气候驱动的径流改变）如何影响沉积物碳循环反馈，结合同位素示踪追踪碳来源。
articles.next_step_perspective: 此研究突出了甲烷循环和孔隙水化学对碳动态的调控，提示我在评估重野化对湿地或水生生态系统碳循环影响时，需考虑动物扰动可能导致的孔隙水变化和甲烷释放，并关注碳的无机形式而非仅有机碳。
articles.why_this_journal: 推测：该研究通过多指标生物地球化学分析揭示沉积物碳循环的复杂控制因素，涉及全球碳收支关键过程，具有学科交叉性和应用价值，符合Biogeosciences对海洋-沉积物界面过程的研究重点。

author_profile.name: Katarzyna Łukawska-Matuszewska
author_profile.intro: Katarzyna Łukawska-Matuszewska来自格但斯克大学，其研究集中于波罗的海沉积物生物地球化学，尤其是甲烷渗漏系统、古菌群落和碳酸盐地球化学，与用户关注动物介导的生物地球化学循环有一定交叉，可提供海洋环境碳循环视角。
